title: Method-style calls
description: Passing a receiver pointer in `rdi` like the System V C++ ABI
theory:
## Receiver in `rdi`

Many ABIs pass the **this** pointer as the first argument. Here small procedures read from the object pointer in `rdi` and issue `write`.

exercises.title: Print tag
exercises.description: Object layout: first byte is tag `'T'`, second byte is payload `'!'` (both in `.data`). Write `show` that takes object pointer in `rdi`, writes **only the tag** (one byte), returns. `_start` passes the object address.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
obj:
    db 'T'
    db '!'
section .text
show:
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel obj]
    call show
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: Save `rdi` to a callee-saved scratch like `r8` before setting syscall args
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
obj:
    db 'T'
    db '!'
section .text
show:
    mov r8, rdi
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, r8
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel obj]
    call show
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Second field
exercises.description: Same object layout (`T` then `!`). Procedure `payload` in `rdi` prints the **second** byte only.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
obj:
    db 'T'
    db '!'
section .text
payload:
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel obj]
    call payload
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
obj:
    db 'T'
    db '!'
section .text
payload:
    mov r8, rdi
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [r8+1]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel obj]
    call payload
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Chained calls
exercises.description: `first` prints `'A'` (one byte). `second` prints `'B'`. `_start` calls `first` then `second`. Both take ignored `rdi` (set to 0 in `_start`).
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    a: db 'A'
    b: db 'B'
section .text
first:
    ret
second:
    ret
_start:
    xor rdi, rdi
    call first
    xor rdi, rdi
    call second
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: Each helper issues its own `write` syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    a: db 'A'
    b: db 'B'
section .text
first:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel a]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    ret
second:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel b]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    ret
_start:
    xor rdi, rdi
    call first
    xor rdi, rdi
    call second
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Emit whole object
exercises.description: Object in `.data`: three bytes `db '1','2','3'`. Procedure `dump` takes object pointer in **`rdi`** and length in **`rsi`** (here `3`), issues one `write`, returns. `_start` passes the object address and `rsi=3`. Expected stdout (trimmed) is `123`.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
obj:
    db '1','2','3'
section .text
dump:
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel obj]
    mov rsi, 3
    call dump
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: Same register shuffle as `emit` in the slices chapter: stash `rdi`/`rsi` before clobbering for the syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
obj:
    db '1', '2', '3'
section .text
dump:
    mov rax, 1
    mov r8, rdi
    mov r9, rsi
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, r8
    mov rdx, r9
    syscall
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel obj]
    mov rsi, 3
    call dump
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
